hypothesis: In a re-run of the Shreesha & Levin (2023) Experiment 1 model (fixed competency 20/100/400 vs hardwired, 100 repeats x 250 generations), the best genotypic fitness of each competent population stops rising and stays below the hardwired population's, its spread across repeats grows with competency, while phenotypic fitness stays high.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered, with 'best genotypic fitness' = the maximum genotypic (pre-development) fitness in the population each generation, as in the authors' code: (A) at generation 250 each competent population's mean best genotypic fitness is below hardwired, one-sided Welch t-test p < 0.001; (B) plateau: for each competency level, |mean of the mean curve over generations 226-250 minus mean over generations 126-150| < 0.03; (C) the across-repeat standard deviation of best genotypic fitness, averaged over generations 51-250, is strictly ordered competency 20 < 100 < 400; (D) mean best phenotypic fitness at generation 250 >= 0.95 for every competency level. All four -> supports.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: refutes if any competent level's mean best genotypic fitness at generation 250 is >= hardwired, or the generation-51-250 SD at competency 400 is below that at competency 20, or any competent level's genotypic mean curve still rises by more than 0.1 between the 126-150 and 226-250 windows. Any other failure of (A)-(D) -> mixed.
planned_datasets: competency-ga-reimplementation-runs (generated by analysis.py, importing the Experiment 1 re-implementation in claim-tests/levin-papers/levin-2023-competency-04/analysis.py)
https://doi.org/10.3390/e25010131 (model specification, Sections 2-3 and Supplement S1)

test_contract.expected_observation: Competent populations' best genotypic fitness rises for a few generations, then flattens below the hardwired curve, with across-repeat spread increasing with competency level and phenotypic fitness near maximal.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Competent genotypic fitness reaching or exceeding hardwired, continuing to climb, or showing less spread at higher competency.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: Runs of the model exactly as specified in the paper and its supplement (50-cell arrays, 100 embryos, top-10% phenotypic selection, crossover, mutation probability 0.6, competency 20/100/400); unspecified details from the authors' public code; fresh random seeds independent of the companion test levin-2023-competency-04.
test_contract.inference_method: Mean curves over 100 repeats; one-sided Welch t-test at generation 250 (alpha 0.001); plateau as window-mean difference < 0.03; spread as mean across-repeat SD over generations 51-250 compared across levels.
